name: IP Classification (under test)
summary: Classifies IP addresses as scanners, C2 and malware families, crawlers, anonymizers and non-routable space.
description:
For the first question about an IPv4 address in a log or a graph: why it is there. Each match is written on the IP with the list that named it (`*_source`) and when that list first and last named the address (`*_first_seen`, `*_last_seen`).

**Covers:** 22 scanning services (Shodan, Censys, Tenable and others), 36 C2 frameworks and malware families (Cobalt Strike, Sliver, Remcos and others), crawlers and AI bots (Googlebot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot and others), VPN entry points of eight providers, Tor exits, SOCKS and SSL proxies, iCloud Private Relay, the RFC 6890 special-use ranges and Team Cymru's bogon list.

**Who sees it:** only GitHub, which serves the address data. A run reads one shard per distinct first octet (/8), so GitHub learns which /8 blocks were looked up, not the addresses. The addresses themselves and the list publishers are never contacted.

**Read results with care:**
- A value records that a published list named the address during the dates given; check the claim against the list in `*_source`.
- VPN values end in `_entry`: providers publish their connection endpoints, not their egress addresses. For every anonymizer value, the address is not the person.
- A public address no list names is left untouched: absence from these lists, not a verdict.

**Data and licences:** ip-observation-history (https://github.com/Vineyard-Intelligence/ip-observation-history), which collects OpenFilters internet-scanners, HL-SOC C2-Tracker, FireHOL, Team Cymru and vendors' own crawler and VPN ranges; its README lists every source.

**Source:** https://github.com/Vineyard-Intelligence/pluginpack-ip-classification (Apache-2.0)

plugins.name: IP Classification
plugins.description: Classifies an IPv4 address by role: internet-wide scanner, C2 or malware family (creating a linked Tool or Malware node), crawler or AI bot, anonymizer (VPN, Tor exit, iCloud Private Relay), or non-routable space. Runs on the selected IP Address nodes. No API key.
